title: Push width further: ASPECT_RATIO 80->96 (model_dim 768)
description: Changed ASPECT_RATIO from 80 to 96, keeping DEPTH=8, DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128, MATRIX_LR=0.06 unchanged. This raises model_dim from 640 to 768 (6 heads instead of 5).
reflection: val_bpb 1.000118, worse than the 0.999094 baseline (dim=640) -- width scaling has saturated (or slightly reversed) between 640 and 768 dims. Peak VRAM 65.8GB, in line with linear-scaling prediction, so this wasn't a VRAM/batch-size artifact. All 6 agents independently proposed this exact same change this round, so this single clean run settles the question for everyone: don't push width past 640 at DEPTH=8 for this 5-min budget. The capacity-bound regime the group identified last round has a ceiling near dim=640-680; next round should look at other axes (e.g. depth+width jointly at similar total params, or revisiting LR/schedule now that architecture has shifted) rather than a further width increment.
